name: China Security Co., Ltd.
summary: China Security Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides security products and services in China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Overseas Security, Security System Integration, Security Product Manufacturing and Sales, and Others. It offers intelligent security products, including intelligent building alarm system, perimeter prevention and alarm system, and indoor security system; smart all in one card platform, intelligent access control, and intelligent parking lot processing system; and on line monitoring equipment for transmission, power safety supervision operation monitoring, and monitoring equipment for mountain fire.
